short_gloss: Main Koppen-Garcia group/subgroup letter combination (A, C, B, D, E families), assigned in ClimGar.R sect.7 from annual/coldest-month/warmest-month temperature thresholds.

Rainfall-regime-specific humidity subtype letter (m/f/w0/w1/w2/x'/s family), assigned in ClimGar.R sect.8 from the precipitation/temperature ratio (P/T) and the pct of annual rain falling in the cold half of the year (PPInv).

Koppen-style temperature-of-warmest-month refinement letter (a/b/b'/c/d for C/D groups; h'/(h')h/h'(h)/h/k/k'/k'' for the B group; H for isothermal polar E), assigned in ClimGar.R sect.9; NOT assigned to A/A(C) types (no letter defined for that group in the source function).
Binary marker 'g' assigned when the warmest month occurs before the boreal summer solstice ('Ganges-type' thermal march per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf); assigned in ClimGar.R sect.10.

Binary marker w'' for intraestival drought / bimodal rainy season within an otherwise A/A(C) summer-humid regime; assigned in ClimGar.R sect.11 only when the climatological July or August mean is a local rainfall minimum.

Three-level classification of when annual rainfall concentrates (summer/winter/intermediate), assigned in ClimGar.R sect.5 from ratios of wettest-summer-month vs. driest month and wettest-winter-month vs. driest-summer-month.
Four-level binned version of Osc (i / (i') / (e) / (e')), assigned in ClimGar.R sect.6 from fixed degC thresholds (5, 7, 14).
Continuous annual range of monthly mean temperature (max of the 12 monthly means minus min of the 12 monthly means), the raw variable that Ampli bins categorically.
Rainy season concentrated in the warm half of the year (wettest-summer-month precip > 10x driest-month precip); most humid/subhumid tropical and temperate types in the domain (~52-58% of cells).
Rainfall distributed through most months without a single dominant wet season; the residual/default category when neither the summer nor the winter concentration criterion is met (~41-47% of cells).

Rainy season concentrated in the cold half of the year (wettest-winter-month precip > 3x driest-summer-month precip, and the annual wettest month falls in winter); Mediterranean-type regime, rare in this domain (0.9-1.4% of cells).
Osc <= 5 degC; annual range of monthly mean temperature essentially flat, typical of humid tropical lowlands. Per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf: 'isotermal'.
5 degC < Osc <= 7 degC. Per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf: 'con poca oscilacion'.
7 degC < Osc <= 14 degC. Per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf: 'extremoso'.
Osc > 14 degC; strongest continentality signal in the domain. Per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf: 'muy extremoso'.
Tmean > 22 degC and coldest-month mean > 18 degC. Corresponds to Koppen group A ('Calido' per Cuadro 1, reglasGarcia.pdf).

real_term_en: Tropical warm-humid climate with a cooler-influenced winter
short_gloss: Tmean > 22 degC but coldest-month mean <= 18 degC -- warm annual mean with a mild cool season. Garcia's semicalido variant of the A group (ClimGar.R sect.7).
18 degC < Tmean <= 22 degC. Transitional between the A and C groups -- Garcia's 'semicalido' subgroup of C (Cuadro 1, reglasGarcia.pdf).

Tmean > 5 degC and coldest-month mean >= -3 degC (evaluated after A/A(C)/(A)C in ClimGar.R sect.7, per the case_when ordering fix documented in R/README.md). Corresponds to Koppen group C ('Templado').

Warmest-month mean >= 10 degC and coldest-month mean < -3 degC (ClimGar.R sect.7). Corresponds to Koppen group D; 0 cells assigned this code standalone in the current domain output (freq_Tclim1.csv both periods) -- the domain's cold climates fall in the E family instead.
Base 'E' (warmest-month mean < 10 degC), refined in ClimGar.R sect.12: coldest-month mean > 0 degC and Tmean > -2 degC. Rare in domain (5 cells, high-elevation).
Base 'E', coldest-month mean <= 0 degC and Tmean > -2 degC (ClimGar.R sect.12). Per Cuadro 4, reglasGarcia.pdf: E(T) group, Tmean between -2 and 5 degC.
Base 'E', warmest-month mean < 0 degC -- no month above freezing (ClimGar.R sect.12; Cuadro 4, reglasGarcia.pdf).

real_term_en: Polar climate, variant NOT independently verified
short_gloss: Residual E branch in ClimGar.R sect.12 (coldest-month mean > -10 degC, not caught by the E(T)C/E(T)/EF conditions above it). NOT found labeled by this name in reglasGarcia.pdf (Cuadro 4 only documents E(T)HC, E(T)H and EFH) -- flagged explicitly as unverified per project instructions rather than guessed. Not observed in the current domain output (0 cells in freq_Tclim1.csv either period), so it has no immediate manuscript impact, but the code path exists.
Annual precipitation below the desert threshold of Garcia's aridity formula (ClimGar.R sect.7; threshold depends on Regi and PPInv). Corresponds to Koppen BW.
Above the BW threshold but below the steppe threshold, with P/T < 22.9 (ClimGar.R sect.7). Corresponds to Koppen BS, drier subtype ('BS0 = seco' per Cuadro 1, reglasGarcia.pdf).
Above the BW threshold but below the steppe threshold, with P/T >= 22.9 (ClimGar.R sect.7). Corresponds to Koppen BS, more humid subtype ('BS1 = semiseco' per Cuadro 1, reglasGarcia.pdf).
C/D group: Tmean>12 degC and warmest-month mean >22 degC (also the only letter assigned to the (A)C transitional group). Koppen 'a' (ClimGar.R sect.9).
C/D group: Tmean>12 degC, warmest-month mean <=22 degC. Koppen 'b' (ClimGar.R sect.9).

real_term_en: Cool, long-summer climate (semi-cold with long warm season)
short_gloss: C/D group, Tmean<=12 degC, with more than 3 months averaging >10 degC. Garcia's Cb' subtype, 'verano fresco largo' per Cuadro 4, reglasGarcia.pdf.
C/D group, Tmean<=12 degC, <=3 months averaging >10 degC, coldest-month mean > -38 degC. Garcia's Cc subtype, 'verano fresco corto' per Cuadro 4, reglasGarcia.pdf.

Assigned in ClimGar.R sect.12 when Tclim1='E' and Osc<10 degC. Per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf: used only for cold E climates that occur at high elevation within Mexico's tropical latitudes (cold from altitude, but low thermal oscillation because of the tropical latitude).
B group: Tmean>22 degC and coldest-month mean >18 degC (ClimGar.R sect.9).

real_term_en: Hot arid climate, transitional toward very hot
short_gloss: B group: Tmean>22 degC, not meeting the strict h' condition on the coldest-month mean. Parenthesis = intergrade notation per the Cuadro 1 footnote of reglasGarcia.pdf.
B group: 18 degC<Tmean<=22 degC with coldest-month mean >18 degC (ClimGar.R sect.9).
B group: Tmean>12 degC, coldest-month mean >-3 degC, warmest-month mean >18 degC (ClimGar.R sect.9).
B group: Tmean>12 degC, coldest-month mean >-3 degC, not meeting the warmest-month>18 degC condition of 'k' (ClimGar.R sect.9).
B group: coldest/residual arid subtype, not meeting any of the h'/(h')h/h'(h)/k/k' conditions above (ClimGar.R sect.9).

Warmest month occurs before the boreal summer solstice (max monthly Tc in Jan-May exceeds max monthly Tc in Jun-Oct, Northern Hemisphere). Per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf: 'marcha de la temperatura tipo Ganges'. Present in ~50-51% of domain cells.

Complement of 'g' -- warmest month occurs at or after the typical summer-solstice timing. NA in ClimGar.R's raw output; relabeled explicitly as 'no_g' in this pipeline's transition analysis (03f_axis_Tclim4.R) because it is a real climatological state, not a missing/dropped cell.

Local rainfall minimum in July or August within an otherwise A/A(C) summer-humid regime (summer precip > half the annual total). Per Cuadro 5, reglasGarcia.pdf: 'sequia intraestival ... epoca seca de medio verano'. Only assigned to A/A(C) climate types (ClimGar.R sect.11). Computed on the 30-year monthly climatology, so it only detects the drought when the driest midsummer month is consistently July or August ON AVERAGE across the normal -- see the interannual-variability caveat in CLAUDE.md.

Summer regime (ver), humid A/A(C) group -- or its C/D/(A)C 'templado' counterpart, written with the base letter in parentheses, e.g. (m). Corresponds to Koppen 'Am': high total rainfall relative to temperature with a brief drier season (ClimGar.R sect.8).
Intermediate rainfall regime (int), humid group -- rainfall distributed through the year without a marked dry season. Corresponds to Koppen 'f' (ClimGar.R sect.8).
Summer regime, subhumid group, at or below the driest of the three subhumid P/T bands (<=43.2 for the A group; ClimGar.R sect.8) -- least humid of the w0/w1/w2 gradient.
Summer regime, subhumid group, middle P/T band (43.2-55.3; ClimGar.R sect.8).
Summer regime, subhumid group, highest P/T band (>=55.3; ClimGar.R sect.8) -- wettest of the w0/w1/w2 gradient, bordering the humid 'm' subtype.

Intermediate rainfall regime (int), subhumid group -- the w0/w1/w2 P/T-band distinction collapses to a single plain 'x'' once winter rain reaches or exceeds 18pct of the annual total (ClimGar.R sect.8); the w0/w1/w2-in-parentheses suffix (see convention rows below) marks the sub-18pct cases where the band distinction still applies.
Winter regime (inv) base subtype -- driest-dry-season variant of the winter-rain (Mediterranean-type) climate, rare in this domain (Regi=inv is 0.9-1.4pct of cells; ClimGar.R sect.8).

Whenever the base Tclim2 letter (m, f, w0, w1, w2) appears wrapped in parentheses -- e.g. (m), (w2) -- it denotes the SAME moisture criterion applied to Tclim1 in {C, D, (A)C, E} instead of {A, A(C)}. Parentheses generically flag a Garcia innovation/variant not present unmodified in the original Koeppen system, per the Cuadro 1 footnote of reglasGarcia.pdf. Verified directly in ClimGar.R sect.8 (separate case_when branches for the two Tclim1 groups).

Trailing parenthetical letter appended to the base Tclim2 code, denoting the pct of annual rain falling in the cold half of the year (PPInv; ClimGar.R sect.4/8). Summer regime: PPInv<5pct appends '(w)', 5-10.2pct leaves the base letter unmodified, >=10.2pct appends '(f)' for humid types or '(x'')' for subhumid/arid types. Intermediate regime: PPInv<18pct appends '(m)' (humid) or the w0/w1/w2 letter in parentheses (subhumid) to the x'/f base; >=18pct drops the suffix. Winter regime: the PPInv<36pct vs >=36pct split governs the f(s)/s(f)/s(x')/s alternation together with the dry-season minimum precip. Exact thresholds verified directly in ClimGar.R sect.4/8 and cross-checked against Cuadro 2 of reglasGarcia.pdf (same breakpoints: 5, 10.2, 18, 36pct of PPInv; 43.2, 55.3 of P/T).
